name: Amplifier Corporation of America (ACA)
notes: The Fuzz King was introduced in summer 1967 under the Amplifier Corp. of America name and is documented in period catalogs and surviving examples. Specialist research identifies the pedal as produced by ACA/Unicord, with U.S. manufacture strongly supported. Preserve Unicord distribution/corporate relationships separately.

name: Sunn
notes: Sunn introduced the Sunn Buzz fuzz/distortion in 1966-67, with period brochure advertising and surviving examples. Preserve Sunn as the maker/brand while treating later corporate ownership separately.
